environment.description: Django REST service deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The EC2 instance has an IAM role with S3 read access and the instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is enabled. No WAF rules attached to the ALB.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, NAT gateway for outbound
